name: The Westin Mission Hills Resort & Spa
positioning: Westin golf and spa resort on 360 acres in Greater Palm Springs, officially named The Westin Rancho Mirage Golf Resort & Spa
best_for: Golfers who want a Pete Dye championship course on site
Families looking for waterslides and several pools
Travelers who want a full-service spa in the desert

facts.text: The resort is at 71333 Dinah Shore Drive, Rancho Mirage, California.
The resort has a Pete Dye-designed championship golf course on site.
The resort has three themed pools, each with its own programming.
La Paloma Pool offers a tranquil setting to relax and unwind.
The spa offers the HaloIR, which combines an infrared sauna with salt therapy.
Rooms and suites have views of the mountains and desert landscape.
All rooms have Westin Heavenly Beds and Westin Heavenly Baths.
Fireside Lounge sits on the 18th hole of the Pete Dye Golf Course and serves tapas and cocktails.
Pinz & Pints has duckpin bowling lanes, draft beers, brewpub eats and classic arcade games.
The resort has pickleball and tennis courts and lap pools.
Pet-friendly rooms offer a Westin Heavenly Dog Bed and a Patio Pooch Menu.

highlights.text: The resort is a 360-acre escape in Greater Palm Springs.
The Pete Dye course is set among rolling hills with views of the surrounding desert mountains.
Las Brisas, the largest pool, has dual 125-foot waterslides, cabana rentals and two bubbling spas.
The full-service spa and salon has a therapy pool, eucalyptus steam rooms and a relaxation lounge.
Premium options include Deluxe Golf View Rooms, an Executive Suite and Presidential Suites, with golf course views.

considerations.text: Tennis, pickleball and padel lessons, clinics and open play run from September to June.
Golf clinics run from October to May.
WhataHotel notes it is a large property that requires walking between facilities.
